Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY Legal Opinion No. 38 s. 2011 THE SECTION R ELEA S ED MAYOR ROMEO O. MAGADAN Municipality of Loreto Province of Agusan Del Sur Dear Mayor Magadan: This has reference to your letter which in sum inquires as to whose mandate should prevail relative to the use of the 20% component of the Annual Internal Revenue Allotment share. Your inquiry arose when an Audit Observation Memorandum (AOM) No. 11- 014 [IO] dated 07 January 2010 from the Commission on Audit (COA) was received by the Municipality of Loreto which found, among others, that upon review of the Municipality's Appropriation Ordinance No. 01,s.2010 approving the Annual Budget for CY 2010, some of "the programs/activities/projects were not eligible under the guidelines set for 200/0 Development Fund as provided under DILG-DBM Joint Memorandum Circular No. 1,s.2005 and Section 287 of RA 7160, amended /supplemented by DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2010-138 dated December 2, 2010 xxx". COA findings further showed that the appropriations for the programs/projects were not used for development projects but to settle the obligations incurred by the Department. Acting on your query, please be informed that DILG MC No. 2010-138 has already been amended by a Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2011-1 dated 13 April 2011. Consistent to its mandate, the Commission on Audit makes an examination and verification of government transaction documents based on existing rules, guidelines, and procedures. As referred to in the COA AOM, the basis used by COA for determining the propriety or eligibility of the programs or projects that may be funded from the 20% development fund are the JMCs issued by DILG and DBM and its own rules. For your further reference and guidance, the DILG-DBM JMC No. 2011-1 shall cover programs and projects to be approved for CY 2012. Very truly yours, JE SE M. ROBREDO Se retary cc: Dir. Manuel Q. Gotis BLGD LS:55/06
